text:
sara_support: FYI Northridge Health just escalated — procurement won't allow invoice issuance without a PO number on file. They're blocking payment until we can provide a PO-bearing invoice.

maria_finance: ok, do they have a vendor setup form already? sometimes AP needs vendor ID + W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU).

raj_sales: I have the customer's procurement contact: emily@nrh-health.org. They said "finance won't accept any invoices without PO# and their internal vendor code."

dan_devex: can we generate an invoice that includes a PO number field? what's our usual metadata flow for invoices?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice generation service status: healthy. Last invoice ID issued: inv_2026_01234.

maria_finance: we can include a PO number on the invoice PDF and in the invoice metadata, but legal/billing needs the customer's official PO string. Ask them to send the exact PO (format matters). Also confirm billing address and tax/vat number.

raj_sales: @sara_support I requested the PO from procurement, they replied with a reference but said they need our vendor onboarding completed first. timeline 5-7 biz days unless we supply additional docs.

ops_legal: do we need to modify contract terms before issuing a PO-backed invoice? usually PO acceptance is implied, but if their PO has special terms, route to legal.

maria_finance: quick checklist for Northridge to provide: 1) PO number string 2) Billing contact + email 3) Vendor form (W-9/VAT) 4) Billing address 5) Any tax withholding instructions.

sara_support: customer says procurement won't process payment without invoice present in their AP portal tied to PO. They can't create the vendor record until invoice exists. circular.

dan_devex: possible workaround: issue a pro forma invoice with PO number placeholder they give, or a "provisional invoice" marked as "Pending PO"? is that allowed?

maria_finance: we can issue a pro-forma labeled "Provisional invoice - pending PO" but most AP teams need an official invoice for vendor setup. Better: request the customer send the PO first (email screenshot) and we'll immediately reissue final invoice with PO embedded.

raj_sales: customer asked if we can accept card on file to bypass PO. They said procurement policy forbids card payments for contracts >$10k.

sara_support: next steps agreed: 1) Raj to get explicit PO string or screenshot of procurement approval 2) Maria to prepare invoice template that includes PO field and VAT lines 3) Dan to confirm we can add PO to invoice metadata and regenerate PDF quickly 4) legal on standby if PO contains conflicting terms.

raj_sales: pinged procurement (EMILY) for PO screenshot and vendor code — replied "on it, expect by EOD" :thumbsup:

dan_devex: confirmed — we have an API to set invoice.metadata.po_number and regenerate PDF. Example: 

```
POST /internal/invoices/regen
{ "invoice_id": "inv_2026_01234", "metadata": { "po_number": "NRH-2026-00987" } }
```

maria_finance: perfect. once we have PO string, I can regen final invoice and mark it as "Issued". I'll also attach VAT note if they provide VAT ID.

ops_legal: if the PO contains any liability or indemnity clauses, forward to legal. otherwise finance can proceed.

sara_support: I'll keep the thread updated. Raj — please drop PO here when you have it and cc finance.

raj_sales: will do. thanks everyone.

billing-bot: [automated] Ticket #SUP-2389 created for "Invoice blocked — PO required". Assignee: maria_finance.

sara_support: closing loop for now, will reopen if procurement pushes back. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
